tagline.en_US: GitQlient is a multi-platform Git client originally forked from QGit. Nowadays it goes beyond of just a fork and adds a lot of new functionality.

description.en_US: GitQlient is a multi-platform graphical Git client designed to simplify repository management. Originally created as a fork of QGit, it provides an expanded set of features for interacting with Git projects. Users can inspect commit history, manage branches, and carry out standard Git workflows through a visual interface.
